epic.name: Correcting and cancelling files
unverifiedAssumptions: Changing a row so it breaks a rule blocks "Check again" until fixed; untouched rows never block it. Right behaviour?
"Save changes" with nothing changed shows a short "No changes to save." message instead of being greyed out. OK?
Not-waiting notice says e.g. "Its current status is Completed." ("Failed, cancelled" for a cancelled file). Wording OK?
A refused cancel shows a problem headed "The file could not be cancelled" with the server explanation underneath. Wording OK?

manualTestResults.by: Claude (delegated by user; automated browser walkthrough against the real back-end)
manualTestResults.notes: Real failed files: partial then full correction (loaded 3 rows with corrected values), save without recheck, not-waiting notice, cancel refused (409, 2 approved) and allowed (content discarded, hidden from dashboard), Importer shortcuts, Approver no-access and no cancel.
